prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Offshore wind O&M; scope Grid Interface Relay (Wildmere); excludes public grid, non-farm port ops. Wildmere: Export Limit Advisory→Grid Dispatcher when capability<target; applies accepted ceiling, records time; keeps protection settings unless authorized switching plan. Turbine Controller (Glassfin): validated commands within protections, blocks conflicts, safe mode on auxiliary loss; Pitch Deviation Notice. Pitch System, Rotor Brake Unit, Converter Cabinet, Nacelle Condition Monitor→Turbine Sensor Bus. Offshore Substation (Morrowick): Main Transformer, export cable, Export Cable Monitor, station service transformers, Fire Detection Panel; Transformer Tap Snapshot→Shore Control Room; mode Substation Degraded. Substation Operator: switching after state check plus Control Engineer authorization; notifies Grid Dispatcher. Emergency Generator (Foxglove): auto-start on auxiliary loss, no unapproved paralleling; Start Test Trace. SCADA Gateway (Juniper Vale): telemetry→Shore Control Room (Amber Quay); Session Revocation Receipt→Cybersecurity Gateway. Shore Control Room keeps last validated limit on comms loss; Switching Window Acknowledgment. Grid Dispatcher priority safety>protection>export. Fleet Dispatch Console (Sable Orchard): Position Quality Flag. Mode Grid Constraint: Duty Planner records basis/authorization/handover; Control Engineer reduces stepwise, restores gradually after authorization. Maintenance Planning Engine (Thistle Crown): Squall Window Bulletin, Deferred Task Rationale. Weather Service→Weather Analyst (Wave Burst Record, Visibility Confidence Note)→Duty Planner. Duty Planner: mobilization (CTV/Daughter Craft/SOV/Helideck), Transfer Manifest Addendum→Vessel Master; restoration after Field Supervisor clear. CTV: Harness Audit Card. SOV: Recovery Basket Load Sheet. Personnel reconciliation: Marine Coordinator sets expected count; separate counts per vessel/location; Vessel Master verifies aboard before departure; North/South Access Scanner record access; Personnel Tracking Console count correction→verified personnel total (reason recorded). Discrepancy: Marine Coordinator pauses transfers, informs Shore Control Room, escalates to Duty Planner; Vessel Master safe position; resume only after Marine Coordinator confirms reconciliation/authorized response; included in shift handover. Software lifecycle: each component has owner, approved version, baseline (versions, parameters, dependencies, hardware revisions); access-controlled repos; changes off live; releases from approved source; SCADA Engineer verifies image via Firmware Hash Attestation before loading; Control Engineer confirms purpose/scope; technical approval before scheduling; extra scrutiny for protection/control; representative

New part:
S611: Operational handover records identify the deployed change, any outstanding limitations, and the responsible technical contact.
S612: Emergency arrangements define who may direct an incident, who supports rescue, and who may authorize a return to work.
S613: The Shore Control Room maintains the incident log and provides a single operational point of contact for offshore teams.
S614: The Rescue Coordinator leads rescue planning and coordinates requests for external assistance.
S615: The Field Supervisor directs personnel at the affected work site until control is formally transferred.
S616: The Vessel Master retains authority over vessel safety, navigation, and decisions to approach or withdraw from a casualty.
S617: The HSE Officer advises on personnel hazards, rescue procedures, and the use of emergency equipment.
S618: The Marine Coordinator maintains awareness of vessel locations, access constraints, and available marine support.
S619: The Personnel Tracking Console supports personnel accounting, but the incident lead verifies headcounts with the teams involved.
S620: Crew Transfer Vessel operations are suspended when sea conditions, visibility, or transfer arrangements exceed approved limits.
S621: A Daughter Craft may support a local response only when its crew, equipment, and launch conditions are suitable.
S622: A Service Operations Vessel may provide accommodation, medical support, and a stable platform when its position and capability permit.
S623: The Helideck is used for evacuation only when aviation conditions, deck readiness, and receiving arrangements are acceptable.
S624: The Weather Service provides forecast information for planning, while operational decisions account for observed local conditions.
S625: The Metocean Buoy provides site measurements that help assess whether a planned response remains feasible.
S626: The Weather Analyst interprets forecast uncertainty and communicates material changes to the Rescue Coordinator.
S627: The Operations Radio Console supports communications between the Shore Control Room, vessels, and offshore work teams.
S628: Emergency Generator readiness is checked as part of site emergency preparedness and restoration planning.
S629: The Fire Detection Panel provides alarm indications that responders use alongside direct reports from personnel on site.
S630: The Control Engineer supports remote shutdown actions when communications and equipment status allow safe intervention.
S631: Electrical recovery work requires qualified personnel, verified isolation, and a safe means of access before hands-on activity begins.
S632: Recovery of injured or incapacitated personnel may be delayed by vessel motion, limited access, lifting capacity, or deteriorating conditions.
S633: Offshore recovery plans identify the point at which continued response would expose rescuers to unacceptable risk.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
